title: How AI Tracks Your Body: Pose Estimation in 60 Seconds 🕺 #shorts
description:
Pose estimation finds the key points of a human body in an image: nose, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles. The model predicts a heatmap for each joint, takes the brightest spot as the joint's position, and links the joints into a skeleton. It powers fitness apps, motion capture, sports analysis and fall detection.

📘 More to learn + my projects: https://github.com/HemashreeVI

#ComputerVision #PoseEstimation #AI #DeepLearning #MMPose #TechExplained #shorts

lines: Your phone can see your skeleton. Every elbow, knee and wrist, live, from a normal camera.
It looks for seventeen key points: nose, eyes, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles.
For each joint, the model paints a heatmap: a glow showing where that joint probably is. The brightest spot wins.
Connect the joints in the right order, and you get a skeleton that moves with the person, frame by frame.
Fitness apps check your squat form. Games capture motion. And in healthcare, it can spot a fall the moment it happens.
Find the joints. Connect them. Track every move.
